The SIGN of s is NOT SETTLED in the literature, and this is the single constitutive quantity in the model for which a sign cannot be fixed from measurement: Suzuki 1996 (PMID 8923151) reports a thicker layer at HIGHER flow velocity (s>0); Kim/Ong 2010 (PMID 20348228) report a thicker layer at REDUCED flow combined with aggregation (s<0); Liao & Chen 2019 (PMID 31768201) report a non-monotonic dependence, negative below and positive above an intermediate shear rate; Salame & Fenech 2025 (PMID 40846133) report the positive sign in plasma and the negative sign in a non-aggregating medium. The main analysis uses s=-0.12. Section 3.7 reports the vessel ranking for s from -0.24 to +0.24: the existence of the ESR-driven rise in WSS variability is independent of the sign, but the most-affected vessel is not (hypoperfused vasa recta for s<0, glomerular capillary for s>0, crossover at s approx +0.02).
